thread:
Aisha (Product PM): ACME wants predictable cold-start elimination for their top tenants. Request: prefetch weights + KV prefixes via a sprint-slot allocator. Target: Q3 pilot. Need runtime/infra/security alignment and clear launch criteria.
Dan (Eng): is this tenant opt-in or global ramp? also: defense in depth if warm cache causes OOMs?
Aisha (Product PM): opt-in for pilot. Product will flip tenant flag. Key goals: cut cold-start p95 for opted tenants, maintain overall p95 parity, and keep cost increase <= 8%.
Priya (Runtime): runtime risks: cache eviction pressure and interference with steady-state batching. I propose a ranked prefetch queue with TTLed "warmed" markers and off-peak execution windows.
Priya (Runtime): rollout config example: {"prefetch.enabled":true,"window":"01:00-04:00UTC","warm_ttl_h":6,"max_concurrent":6}. Prefetch should be non-blocking for live requests.
Jorge (Infra): infra asks: estimated GPU-minutes per tenant prefetch, concurrency profile, and whether we need ephemeral disk for warmed checkpoints. New SKUs take ~48h to provision; prefer to reuse existing pools. I'll open a capacity ticket.
Dan (Eng): runtime should emit low-cardinality metrics: prefetch_pending, prefetch_success_pct, warmed_tenants_count, prefetch_gpu_mins. Add trace tag warm=true/false to path.
Priya (Runtime): agreed. We'll keep metrics aggregated by customer tier to limit cardinality.
Lena (Security): if prefetch touches encrypted artifacts or calls KMS, we need audit events and rate limits. Confirm: ephemeral memory-only cache?
Aisha (Product PM): yes ephemeral. Product also requires an auditable opt-in event and a rule that prefetch must not load PII.
Lena (Security): acceptance checklist: opt-in/out audit events emitted, code review for key access, and KMS rate-limiting if used.
Dan (Eng): proposed timeline for MVP: 0-2w spike (queue + metrics + autoscaler knobs), week 3 internal canary (5 tenants), weeks 4-5 validation, week 6 customer pilot. Tight but doable.
Jorge (Infra): note: autoscaler tuning may require new node labels or taints; that'll be in the infra ticket. If new SKUs are needed add 48h.
Priya (Runtime): runtime acceptance criteria: warm path reduces cold-start p95 by >=40% on test suite; peak overhead <5% on CPU/GPU; feature-flag allows immediate drain and rollback.
Aisha (Product PM): combined launch criteria: - pilot p95 improvement met - total cost delta <=8% - security checklist complete - canary stable for 2 weeks with alert thresholds OK.
Dan (Eng): test plan: tenant workload replay, warm/unwarm e2e cycles, chaos on prefetch worker to validate rollback. Canary alerts: prefetch_fail_rate >1% or warmed_tenant_errors spike -> automated rollback.
Lena (Security): I'll schedule a short review; need opt-in event schema and PR link.
Priya (Runtime): I'll open a PR tomorrow with queue, TTL logic, metrics, and feature flag.
OpsBot: deploy-bot scheduled deploy/canary-prefetch 2026-04-06T03:00:00Z and will ping #eng-oncall.
Aisha (Product PM): ask: reply with "ack" + estimate (hrs) by EOD so I can lock into the roadmap.
Dan (Eng): ack 36h (implementation + tests).
Priya (Runtime): ack 48h (queue, metrics, rollout config, tests).
Jorge (Infra): ack 20h (ticket + autoscaler tuning), +48h if new SKUs needed.
Lena (Security): ack 6h (review + follow-ups).
Aisha (Product PM): thanks all — I'll draft the formal spec and slot this into Q3 slate.
